svg.text: Pulls data from sources into dated, browsable snapshots on local drives (repositories). Solid = v1, dashed = later.

raw database folders (pgdata) are never copied, only dumps
macOS, Linux or Windows paths, e.g. C:/Users/jan/Documents

prune · pin · label · repo sync · stats

dashboard · run with live log + summary

index cache: last snapshots, also of

Backup run (per target, one connection to the host)
resumes after interruption · keeps the computer awake · prints a run summary (new / changed / deleted, time, size)
Transfer engines (engine: auto picks the best one)
find + tar over SSH · hashes while copying
needs rsync ≥ 3.1 on both ends · hardlink drives
Connection (where data comes from) → Transfer engine (how it moves) → Store (where it is kept)
hardlink storage · every snapshot is a complete tree
